summary: Diff adds defensive utilities for error messaging, number formatting, and pickup timestamp conversions, and updates EditDeleteRecordDialog and PickupList to use them—addressing crash/blank-screen risks from malformed data. However, the diff summary is truncated around the edit/delete action handlers, so it’s not fully verifiable that save/delete flows always return to the pickup list and surface failures via toast as required.

missing_requirements.requirement: Ensure the Edit/Delete Record actions still work end-to-end after the regression fix: saving an edited pickup updates successfully and returns the user to the pickup list; deleting removes the pickup and returns to the pickup list; errors are surfaced via existing toast messaging rather than a blank screen.
missing_requirements.reason: EditDeleteRecordDialog.tsx is truncated before the action handlers (save/delete). While hooks/mutations and toast utilities are imported, the diff summary does not show the actual logic that (1) calls updatePickup/deletePickup successfully, (2) transitions the dialog back to the list view after success, and (3) catches backend/network errors to show an English toast while keeping the UI usable.
